clientVersions.syncStrictDesc: Every update overwrites the player's local copy of this file with the server version (for mods/configs that must stay identical)

clientVersions.syncIgnoreDesc: Listed but never sent — the client leaves this file completely alone (player's own)
clientVersions.syncModeHint: Sync policy = how each file is handled on player update: overwrite (force identical) · once (only if missing) · ignore (leave alone)
clientVersions.managedDirsHint: For the dirs listed here (e.g. mods, config), a player update auto-deletes files in those dirs that the server removed but still linger on the player's side — preventing stale mods from breaking the game. Separate multiple with commas or newlines; leave empty to auto-clean nothing.
clientVersions.stepFilesDesc: Select or drag in the client files/folders to publish (mods, configs, resource packs, etc.). Files are staged locally in the browser first and uploaded only when you click Publish.
clientVersions.stepConfigureDesc: For each file, set where it goes in the player's game directory, its sync policy (overwrite / once / ignore), and target platform.
clientVersions.stepReviewDesc: Review, then publish. Once published, this version becomes the latest that players auto-download (version numbers only increase, so players are never downgraded).
clientVersions.zipHint: Uploading a .zip unpacks it in the browser and arranges it into the tree below by its internal directory structure; loose files, folders, and zips can be mixed and accumulated.
clientVersions.lockedHint: File content is locked (content-addressed sha256 is immutable); you can only arrange path/dir, sync policy, target platform, or remove.
clientVersions.contentLocked: Content locked (content-addressed; bytes cannot be changed, only arranged or removed)
clientVersions.dragArrangeHint: Drag file or directory nodes to other directories to batch-change their target paths
clientVersions.previewHint: Click a file on the left to view its content (text/config/JSON highlighting; binary or oversized files can only be downloaded).
clientVersions.artifactNoContent: This file has no previewable artifact content.
clientVersions.artifactMissing: The artifact content is missing, likely deleted from the artifact library. The version manifest remains, but preview and download are unavailable.
clientVersions.discardDesc: You have an arrangement draft for {{n}} uploaded file(s) (files are on the server, but which to publish and their paths/policies are not). Closing discards this arrangement; you'll need to set it up again.
clientVersions.managedDirsTreeHint: Check the directories to include in auto-cleanup (supports deep nesting, e.g. config/foo). When checked, a player update auto-deletes files in these dirs that the server removed but still linger on the player's side. Leave unchecked to auto-clean nothing.
clientVersions.managedDirsTreeEmpty: No directories yet — add files and the directories derived from the draft will be listed here for checking.
clientVersions.managedDirsManualHint: The tree only lists directories derived from draft files; to clean dirs outside the draft (e.g. mods), add them here, comma-separated.
clientVersions.cleanAllHint: When enabled, a player update deletes everything in the game directory not listed in the manifest, except saves/screenshots/logs and the custom exclusions below. Dangerous: files the player placed in the game dir outside protected zones will also be deleted; requires a confirmation before publishing.
clientVersions.cleanExcludeHint: List player-installed mods, personal configs, etc. that are never deleted, even with "wipe entire game directory" enabled. Press Enter to add; multiple allowed.
clientVersions.cleanAllConfirmTitle: Confirm wiping the entire game directory?
clientVersions.cleanAllConfirmDesc: Publishing with "wipe entire game directory" enabled will delete files in the player's channel game directory that are not listed in the manifest and not in protected zones or custom exclusions. This is irreversible — please confirm.
clientVersions.cleanScopeTreeHint: Right-click a directory to mark it as clean (red) or exclude (green). Ctrl+click to toggle selection, Shift+click to range-select, then right-click to batch-mark. Marking a parent propagates to children; changing a child's mark turns the parent mixed (orange).

clientGuide.intro: The wedge self-locates before the game starts, loads updater-core, fetches the manifest and verifies file SHA-256 values, incrementally updates client resources, then launches the game; on network failure or config error it always launches anyway (fail-static / fail-open) and never blocks startup. Follow the steps below to integrate the updater into your modpack and ship it to players.
clientGuide.step1Desc: Download only wedge.jar (~30KB). updater-core is no longer bundled — the wedge fetches it automatically from the API root endpoint on first launch.
clientGuide.step2Desc: Put wedge.jar and jm-updater.json into the jm-updater subfolder of the game directory:
clientGuide.step3Desc: Below is this channel's config. Use a pull key created in the Pull Keys tab (its plaintext can be viewed anytime and filled automatically); endpoint must be the public API root, for example http://127.0.0.1:18370/api/v1. Do not add suffixes such as /client-channels.
clientGuide.keyPlaceholder: Create a key in the Pull Keys tab, then paste it here
clientGuide.keyFilledHint: The selected key plaintext has been written into jm-updater.json below.
clientGuide.keyNotRevealable: This key plaintext cannot be revealed. Edit it to a known value in the Pull Keys tab, then select it again.
clientGuide.step4Title: ④ Add the JVM argument in the launcher
clientGuide.step4Desc: Add the line below to the custom JVM arguments in HMCL / PCL2 (relative path, recommended). Launchers cd into the .minecraft directory before starting the game, so the relative path resolves against the game directory; omitting =gameDir lets the wedge read the absolute gameDir from the MC command line's --gameDir.
clientGuide.step4Abs: If your launcher does not cd into .minecraft, use an absolute path:
clientGuide.behaviorFailStatic: Offline / endpoint unreachable → launches with the existing local version (fail-static).
clientGuide.behaviorFailOpen: Missing / invalid config → skips the update and launches directly (fail-open). Never blocks startup.
clientGuide.behaviorProgress: A standalone progress window (bar + speed + ETA) appears during updates; degrades to text in headless environments.
clientGuide.behaviorMultiAgent: Coexists with other -javaagent such as authlib-injector (third-party login), order-independent.
clientGuide.downloadFailed: Download failed (jar may not be embedded)
clientGuide.coreAutoFetchHint: updater-core is not in the modpack — the wedge fetches it from endpoint automatically; operators can switch/rollback in the Core Version tab.

clientDistFlow.title: How does distribution work?
clientDistFlow.subtitle: First release vs. day-to-day updates at a glance
clientDistFlow.first1: Create a distribution channel (one per server).
clientDistFlow.first2: Create a pull key — the player updater's keycard. Keep it safe and viewable anytime; lose it and players stop receiving updates.
clientDistFlow.first3: Publish the first version: upload files or a zip modpack → arrange the directory tree → publish, and the system generates the file manifest and SHA-256 values.
clientDistFlow.first4: Pack it for players: include only wedge.jar + config (channel + key); the wedge fetches updater-core automatically on first launch.
clientDistFlow.first5: Hand out the modpack once — you never have to re-send the modpack again.
clientDistFlow.daily1: You publish a new version in the panel.
clientDistFlow.daily2: Players update automatically on launch: wedge → fetches and loads updater-core → fetches the file manifest with the key → verifies SHA-256 → downloads only changed files → enters the game.
clientDistFlow.daily3: If anything goes wrong, it rolls back to the last good version automatically and players still get in.
clientDistFlow.tipPackage: The modpack ships only once; from then on this system handles updates automatically — no need to re-send the modpack.
clientDistFlow.tipKey: Don't lose the key — it's the player's update keycard (its plaintext is viewable anytime here); if it's truly lost, rotate it and re-send the config.
clientDistFlow.tipWedge: The wedge is fixed and rarely touched; only the updater-core is what you upgrade or roll back.
